title: An Introduction to SQLite
summary: A 2006 Google TechTalk in which SQLite's author Richard Hipp introduces the embeddable, zero-configuration C database library. He covers its history, strengths and weaknesses, and where it beats client/server databases.
why: Recommended as a first-hand intro from SQLite's creator that also teaches how a database engine is built.

quote.text: is actually a pretty good intro on to how to build your own DB engine.
